name: Non-hierarchical Clustering (k-means / DBSCAN)
when_to_use: Standardized metric variables; k-means requires the number of clusters defined a priori, DBSCAN groups by density without defining k; preferable to hierarchical on larger datasets.

expected_input.question: How to group observations by similarity?

plain_explanation.purpose: Splits items into a number of groups you choose (k-means) or into regions of high concentration (DBSCAN).
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the dataset is large and you already have an idea of how many groups you want, or want to isolate cases that belong to no group.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with one item per row and numeric columns, preferably on the same scale.
plain_explanation.example: Split customers into 4 purchase profiles; or find suppliers with out-of-pattern behavior.
plain_explanation.diagram: loose points -> random centers -> each point goes to the nearest center -> centers adjust -> repeat
